name: Bakery
description:
Ovens with their fuel, for baking.

Bots:
• Baker

In each area:
• Ovens: ovens
• Fuel: Oven(Branch): stockpiles of branches (fuel is only taken from stockpiles)

Also needed:
• Something to light it with: a torch, two or more branches in your inventory, or a lit candelabrum in a Candelabrum area (Smelter Yard).
• A TAKE area for your dough and PUT areas for what you bake.
